qualification: local pinned-fixture reliability investigation; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

failureBeingContained.signature: EXC_BAD_ACCESS / SIGBUS / EXC_ARM_DA_ALIGN with PC = LR = 0x6e
failureBeingContained.interpretation: The generated memory epilogue loaded a guest-like value as its host return address. The exact overwrite source remains unproven because the failed mask candidate did not change emitted machineWords.
failureBeingContained.containment: Memory-capable generated blocks refresh append-only context words with the incoming host FP/LR on every entry and restore those trusted values from the context. Generated stack storage no longer supplies FP/LR at RET.

verification.focused: 19 tests in 3 suites passed, covering context layout, emitted frame encodings, real helper execution, and metadata-fault recovery.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,546 tests in 179 suites passed; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the same pinned inputs were executed explicitly twice.
verification.emissionInvariant: Memory blocks contain context stores/loads for host FP/LR and contain neither the old stack-pair prologue nor the old stack-pair epilogue.

disposition.reason: Both independent production runs crossed the prior approximate 208.8-second failure window, two code-cache wraps, all seven authenticated workloads, and clean ACPI poweroff without an invalid generated return.
disposition.recoveryMasks: Tier-one masks remain conservative. Exact-mask analysis must be reintroduced and separately pass the production reliability gate before A05.4 can close.

limitations: Two passing local runs establish bounded evidence for the containment, not proof of the original overwrite mechanism.
The former crashing candidate has not yet been rerun on top of this hardening.
This evidence does not satisfy the greater-than-95-percent dispatcher gate or G1-G5.
